pendulum.legend.title: How to read this
pendulum.legend.body: Each dot is one voice on the image of Lenin. Horizontally — the tone, from sharp criticism (left) to veneration (right). Vertically — the year of the statement or of the key work.
pendulum.legend.curve: The pendulum is a ten-year moving average

museums.timeline.subtitle: Lenin museums · from 1923 to today
museums.map.subtitle: Lenin museums on the map · 1923–2026
timeline.legend.title: How to read this
timeline.legend.body: Each bar is the working life of a museum. The year of opening is on the left, the year of closing — or today — on the right. The red vertical band at 1991–93 marks the break-up of the Central Lenin Museum and most of its branches.
timeline.legend.transformed: Transformed — the building lives on, the subject changed
map.legend.title: How to read this
map.legend.body: Each dot is a Lenin museum; the colour is its fate. Where dots overlap, a tap opens the topmost one and a second tap opens its neighbour.
